stories.title: Thornton Blowup — Cubs Drop Game 1 Despite 8 Runs Scored
stories.angle: David Peterson gave them 5 IP, 8 K, 2 ER. Trent Thornton entered the 6th with a lead and allowed 5 ER in 0.2 IP — Trevino 2-run HR, Stephenson 3-run blast. Cubs scored 8, still fell short.

x_posts.label: Post 1A
x_posts.text:
Trent Thornton had gone 10 scoreless August innings across 11 outings.

Friday, he allowed 5 runs in 0.2 IP. Trevino 2-run HR. Stephenson 3-run blast. Peterson's 8 strikeouts in 5 innings didn't matter.

The offense put up 8 runs. Still came up short.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Bullpen Red Flag With October Approaching
stories.angle: Thornton's August ERA went from 0.00 (10 scoreless innings) to 4.22 in 0.2 innings. Sun-Times says key relievers may be regressing to the mean. September roster expansion opens Tuesday — Wiggins has 4 straight scoreless Iowa outings.

x_posts.label: Post 2A
x_posts.text:
Thornton's ERA went from 0.00 to 4.22 in one inning.

Cubs relievers are showing cracks at the worst time. The Sun-Times noticed. Counsell needs answers before October.

September callups open Tuesday. Wiggins has 4 straight scoreless Iowa outings.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: PCA MVP Watch — .279/32 HR/31 SB, No. 1 in All of Baseball
stories.angle: PCA at .279 BA, .932 OPS, 32 HR, 31 SB, 7.9 bWAR — leads all of baseball in WAR. 29 of 37 MLB experts voting him NL MVP. Back-to-back 30-30 seasons, first Cubs player ever to do it consecutively.

x_posts.label: Post 3A
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong: .279 BA, 32 HR, 31 SB, 7.9 bWAR — No. 1 in all of baseball.

29 of 37 MLB experts are voting him NL MVP. Back-to-back 30-30 seasons — first Cub to ever do it in consecutive years.

September is just the curtain call.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Wild Card Watch — Cubs 76-59 WC1, Cardinals Fading
stories.angle: Cubs at 76-59, still holding WC1 despite Friday's loss. Brewers 83-51. Cardinals 67-68, fading out of the Wild Card picture. 27 games left in the regular season.

x_posts.label: Post 4A
x_posts.text:
Cubs: 76-59. Still holding NL WC1 after Friday's loss.

Brewers: 83-51, running away with the division. Fine.

Cardinals: 67-68, late August. Somehow still breathing. Won't be for long.

The stretch run is a 27-game sprint from here. Every game matters.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: Game 2 Preview — Gausman vs Abbott, 1:20 PM CT at Wrigley
stories.angle: Gausman last start: 7 IP, 0 ER, 6 K vs D-backs — his best Cubs start. Abbott has a 4.15 ERA; Cubs knocked him out in the 4th earlier this season. Bounce-back opportunity.

x_posts.label: Post 5A
x_posts.text:
Kevin Gausman. Wrigley. 1:20 PM CT.

Last start: 7 IP, 0 ER, 6 K vs the D-backs. That's what the Cubs got at the deadline.

Andrew Abbott (4.15 ERA) starts for Cincinnati. Cubs chased him in the 4th earlier this year.

Time to bounce back.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Matt Shaw Returns From IL
stories.angle: Shaw activated from 10-day IL on Friday (August 28) after nearly two months out. Line: .246/.322/.415 in 56 games, versatile across all infield spots and outfield. Alcántara optioned but returns Sept 1 with expansion.

x_posts.label: Post 6A
x_posts.text:
Matt Shaw is back on the active roster — activated from the IL Friday after nearly two months out.

His 2026 line: .246/.322/.415 in 56 games, with reps at every infield spot and the outfield.

September callups open Tuesday. The Cubs just got deeper.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB
